title: 第二十章   郑乔文
content_zh:
苏林依跟孙依诗对于这次绑架惊魂未定，但安全过后，松了口气的同时，便觉得有些疲惫，苏林依跟孙依诗没有继续去上学，而是让唐大生在学校请了一天的假期，回到别墅静养一天。

    “小诗，你说陈木他到底是什么人，他这么厉害，但他在学校一点都不出名。”苏林依回到别墅后，心里便定了下来，不再那么害怕了。

    “依依姐，我也觉得陈木好像挺厉害的，不过做我们两的跟班也算合格，嘻嘻，你说这次陈木救了我们两个，我们还让他住在外面是不是有点过分啊。”孙依诗说道，其实孙依诗从一开始就觉得陈木应该不简单，或者说那就是一种感觉，普通的男生见到她们两个，恐怕说话都会紧张，而陈木似乎遇到什么事都十分淡定的模样

    “难道要让陈木住在别墅里面啊？”苏林依瞪了孙依诗一眼，有些没好气的说道，不过苏林依心里却觉得就算是让陈木住在别墅好像也没前几天那么反感了，不过总是让陈木住在别墅外的小木屋，确实有点委屈陈木。

    那个小屋子，也是小时候自己觉得好玩，随意搭建的，里面虽然设施不错，但破旧了些。

    “依依姐，要不我们请陈木吃顿饭吧，毕竟他这次真的救了我们，如果没有他，我们还不知道会怎么样呢，也不知道伯父是怎么发现陈木的，竟然这么厉害。”孙依诗谈到陈木的时候，双眼有些放亮。

    “恩，今天已经请假了，刚好我们还没吃无法，就一起去吃顿午饭吧。”苏林依想了想说道。

    “好啊，我这就去通知那块木头去。”孙依诗嘻嘻一笑，就跑到楼下去了。

    “木头？”苏林依一愣，不过想了想，陈木确实像个木头一样，好像什么事都跟他无关似的，苏林依感觉有些看不透陈木这个人，表面看去只不过是不喜欢说话，但似乎又不是那样，总之给苏林依的感觉很奇怪。

    ……

    陈木回到院子里，看了一下银叶草，顺便浇灌了一些水，便看到孙依诗快速的跑到自己跟前。

    “木头哥，我跟依依姐决定，今天请你吃饭，嘻嘻，你不会拒绝吧。”孙依诗说完拍了拍陈木的肩膀。

    “好。”陈木一愣，没有犹豫直接答应了下来，刚好他有好几天没有吃饭了，既然苏林依两女想要请他吃饭，吃顿饭补充一下体力也是不错的。
content_en:
Su Linyi and Sun Yishi were in shock about the kidnapping, but after they were safe, they breathed a sigh of relief and felt a little tired. Instead of continuing to go to school, Su Linyi and Sun Yishi asked Tang Dasheng to take a day off from school and return to the villa to rest for a day.

"Xiao Shi, who do you think Chen Mu is? He is so powerful, but he is not famous at all in school." After Su Linyi returned to the villa, she calmed down and was no longer so scared.

"Sister Yiyi, I also think that Chen Mu is quite powerful, but being a follower of the two of us is considered qualified. Hehe, you said that Chen Mu saved us two this time, and we let him live outside, isn't it a bit too much?" Sun Yishi said. In fact, Sun Yishi felt that Chen Mu should not be simple from the beginning, or that was a feeling. Ordinary boys would be nervous when they saw the two of them talking, but Chen Mu seemed to be very calm about everything.

"Are we going to let Chen Mu live in the villa?" Su Linyi glared at Sun Yishi and said angrily. However, Su Linyi felt in her heart that even if Chen Mu was allowed to live in the villa, she was no longer as disgusted as she was a few days ago. However, Chen Mu was indeed a bit wronged by always letting Chen Mu live in a cabin outside the villa.

That small house was built randomly for fun when I was a child. Although the facilities inside were good, it was a little worn out.

"Sister Yiyi, why don't we treat Chen Mu to a meal? After all, he really saved us this time. Without him, we don't know what would have happened. We don't know how uncle discovered that Chen Mu was so powerful." Sun Yishi's eyes brightened when she talked about Chen Mu.

"Well, I've already asked for leave today. We haven't eaten yet, so let's go have lunch together." Su Linyi thought for a while and said.

"Okay, I'll go notify the piece of wood right away." Sun Yishi smiled and ran downstairs.

"Wood?" Su Linyi was stunned, but after thinking about it, Chen Mu did look like a piece of wood, as if nothing had anything to do with him. Su Linyi felt that he couldn't see through Chen Mu. On the surface, he just didn't like to talk, but it didn't seem like that. In short, it gave Su Linyi a very strange feeling.

…

Chen Mu returned to the yard, looked at the silver-leaf grass, poured some water, and saw Sun Yishi running towards him quickly.

"Brother Mu Mu, Sister Yiyi and I have decided to treat you to dinner today, hehe, you won't refuse, right?" Sun Yishi patted Chen Mu on the shoulder after finishing speaking.

"Okay." Chen Mu was stunned and agreed directly without hesitation. He happened to have not eaten for several days. Since Su Linyi and the two wanted to treat him to a meal, it would be good to have a meal to replenish his physical strength.
